method.fingerprint_algorithm: Literal run_agent.py path/NUL/filebytes/NUL concatenation plus sorted dependency-version JSON, reproduced without importing run_agent.

scope_and_limitations: All134 historical allowlisted files are compared to the original frozen ZIP and its manifest, including support/test/doc files. The inference fingerprint itself covers the listed42 source/requirements files and 21 package-version entries.

Only scripts/v3_full_run.py differs among full-run pinned sources: answer-blind classifier provenance/JWT runtime recovery and resume timing amendments. V3 agent roles/prompts/protocol/scorer/tool implementations remain byte-identical to the corrected original design.
The fingerprint identifies source bytes and declared/transitive package-version metadata; it does not attest every installed package binary or continuously prove historical process memory/state.
No configuration/credentials were read, no inference/scoring/provider modules imported, and no API calls or live source/process mutations occurred.
